description: Send one email through a registered smtp_resource or sendgrid_resource -- a mid-chain notification step, not a bulk per-row campaign tool.

provider.label: Provider
provider.description: Which registered resource's send_email(...) to call -- an SMTPResourceComponent's or a SendGridResourceComponent's resource_key.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key of the registered smtp_resource / sendgrid_resource (matching `provider`).

bcc.label: Bcc
bcc.description: Bcc recipient email addresses -- receive the message, never added as a header.

from_addr.label: From Addr
from_addr.description: Sender address. For provider='smtp', defaults to the resource's own configured username when unset. For provider='sendgrid', required (SendGrid has no notion of a default sender tied to API-key auth).

attachment_paths.label: Attachment Paths
attachment_paths.description: Local file paths to attach, read and attached at materialization time. MIME type is guessed from the file extension.

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Log what would be sent (recipients, subject, attachment paths) and skip the actual send -- no resource is looked up, nothing goes over the network. Output metadata always includes dry_run so a materialization history shows which runs were real.

run_window.label: Run Window
run_window.description: 'HH:MM-HH:MM tz [day,day,...]' (e.g. '09:00-17:00 America/New_York mon,tue,wed,thu,fri'). Outside this window, the asset SKIPS cleanly instead of sending or failing -- no email goes out. Checked once per materialization, before any send. A malformed spec fails open (never blocks). Unset (default): always runs.

pool.label: Pool
pool.description: Dagster's native named concurrency pool (e.g. Airflow's `pool` -- a fixed number of slots shared across every asset/op using the same pool name, e.g. an SMTP-server connection-rate cap). The pool's own slot count is configured at the deployment level (dagster.yaml's concurrency: pools:, or the Dagster+ UI), not here.

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries
